key.name: finder-show-button
key.description: A logo at the top bar's far left with the system menu (About This System, Settings, App Store, Extensions, Sleep, Restart, Shut Down). Stands aside while WACK Shell shows its own logo.

key.name: finder-logo-mode
key.description: fedora: Fedora's emblem, in monochrome. mk: the MK emblem. apple: an apple. distro: your distribution's own logo (os-release). custom: the image in finder-custom-logo-path. none: the label only.

key.name: finder-custom-logo-path
key.description: An SVG or PNG (for example ~/.config/mk/logo.svg), used when finder-logo-mode is custom.

key.name: finder-icon-size
key.description: The logo's size in the top bar, 14 to 30 px (follows the slider live).

key.name: finder-logo-circular
key.description: A custom picture as the logo is cropped to a circle (like an avatar), filling it.

key.name: finder-show-label
key.description: Text beside the logo (finder-label-text).

key.name: finder-label-text
key.description: Finder, MK, Workspace, your name... Empty: the logo only.

key.name: calendar-quick-add
key.description: Opens the calendar with the reminder box ready to type in (again: closes it).

key.name: snap-layouts
key.description: Five layouts; 1-5 tiles the focused window and the others on this desktop.

key.name: coder-desktop
key.description: An editor, a terminal and a browser on localhost onto a fresh desktop, side by side.

key.name: dock
key.description: The glass dock. It only shows while Dash to Dock is off.

key.name: dock-style
key.description: obsidian-glass: Obsidian Frosted Glass. crystal-clear: Crystal Clear Translucent. tahoe-pill: macOS Tahoe Pill (fully round ends). cyber-neon: Cyberpunk Neon Edge. floating-icons: Minimal Floating Icons (no backplate). Also cupertino-frost, spider-glow, minimal-flat.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: How solid the glass styles' tint is (obsidian-glass, crystal-clear, tahoe-pill, cyber-neon): 0.10 nearly clear, 0.95 nearly solid.

key.name: dock-glow-color
key.description: A hex colour (#rrggbb) for the running dots and the focused app's under-glow, and the edge glow of the glow looks (spider-glow: Spider-Verse Crimson Glow, cyber-neon).

key.name: dock-corner-radius
key.description: The shelf's corners (the Tahoe pill is always fully round).

key.name: dock-focused-raise
key.description: The app you're working in sits a little higher and larger (1.15x, 9 px up) on a tile in the glow colour; the others stay at rest.

key.name: panel-backdrop-mode
key.description: The full-width strip behind the top bar's capsules: adaptive-solid (frosted on a clean desktop, solid black while an app window is open), always-blurred (frosted everywhere).

key.name: dock-animation-style
key.description: How the dock goes away when a window overlaps it and comes back: fade-scale (Soft Fade), elastic-slide (Elastic Slide), magnetic-wave (Magnetic Wave: the icons near the pointer swell too), instant-glass (Instant Glass).

key.name: dock-icon-glass
key.description: Each dock icon on a small pane of frosted glass (8 % white, a 16 % edge, 14 px corners, a soft shadow); the running dots glow in the glow colour.

key.name: dock-indicator-style
key.description: glowing-dot, wide-pill (a short dash), underline (a thin line).

key.name: dock-icon-size
key.description: The icons' size at rest; they grow under the pointer (dock-hover-scale).

key.name: dock-hover-scale
key.description: How much the icon right under the pointer grows (and it lifts 12 px); only that one icon, so the dock never shifts. 1.00: off.

key.name: blur
key.description: Blur behind the top bar islands, the dock and the switcher. Paused while a window is full screen; off while Blur my Shell is on.

key.name: fresh-snip
key.description: The screenshot tool opens with no box (not last time's): drag any area.

key.name: snip-auto-capture
key.description: Letting go of a new area takes the screenshot at once (saved and copied).

key.name: top-bar-style
key.description: islands: three floating glass capsules. edge: one seamless glass bar.

key.name: show-active-app
key.summary: Active app in the top bar
key.description: The focused app's icon (in its own colours) and name, with a menu for its window.

key.name: tray-collapsed
key.description: Apps' tray icons sit behind the chevron at the start of the right island; a click shows them.

key.name: media-previous
key.description: One press, one skip: key repeat is ignored and presses within 350 ms count once.

key.name: media-next
key.description: One press, one skip: key repeat is ignored and presses within 350 ms count once.

key.name: qs-hidden
key.description: Any of dark-style, airplane-mode, welcome-light. [] shows everything.
